title: Enhanced image forensics through partial C2PA-based provenance information
abstract: arXiv:2610.38639v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Cryptographically verifiable C2PA-based Content Credentials (CCs) can be attached to freshly acquired or generated digital images but also to already existing ones with no previous provenance information, for instance after processing through trusted C2PA-enabled software tools. The latter case leads to images with so-called partial CCs, which capture only the last operations applied, while prior provenance remains unknown and can be investigated through signal forensics. This paper addresses the forensic analysis of such images, highlighting the opportunity to leverage the partial CCs as additional trusted knowledge to adapt forensic detectors towards the statistical characteristics of the image under analysis and mitigate potential distribution shifts. translated_title: 通过基于C2PA的部分来源信息增强图像取证
translated_abstract: 可密码学验证的基于C2PA的内容凭证（Content Credentials, CCs）不仅可以附加到新采集或新生成的数字图像上，还可以附加到原本没有来源信息的已有图像上，例如在经过受信任的支持C2PA的软件工具处理后。后一种情况会产生带有所谓“部分CCs”的图像，这类凭证仅记录了最近施加的操作，而先前的来源信息仍然未知，需要通过信号取证手段加以调查。本文针对此类图像的取证分析展开研究，强调了利用部分CCs作为额外可信知识的机会，据此调整取证检测器使其适应该图像的统计特性，并缓解潜在的分布偏移问题。为此，本文提出一种两步策略：（i）通过对部分CCs的结构分析，重建最后签署者所施加的操作；（ii）利用所获得的（信息……）
tldr: 本文提出一种两步取证策略，先通过结构分析图像中的部分C2PA内容凭证重建最后的操作，再将这些可信信息用于调整取证检测器以适应图像统计特性、缓解分布偏移，从而提升图像取证性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a two-step forensic strategy that reconstructs the last signer's operations from partial C2PA Content Credentials and leverages this trusted information to adapt forensic detectors to the image's statistical characteristics, mitigating distribution shifts and enhancing image forensics.
